e.summary_en: Australia’s actuarial professional body and qualification pathway: career routes, CPD, industry events and data-science practice resources
e.summary_hk: 澳洲精算專業團體與資格體系：精算師路徑、CPD、行業活動與數據科學實踐資源
e.body: 澳洲精算学会（Actuaries Institute，`actuaries.asn.au`）是**澳大利亚的精算专业团体与资格授予机构**，站点结构围绕职业路径展开：What is an actuary / Why become an actuary / **Career paths for actuaries**、如何成为精算师（资格路径）、会员与 CPD、行业活动与政策倡导，并对外发布研究与实践资源。它对 RIAA 的价值有三层：① **区域资格路径**——澳洲是亚太精算人才流动的重要一极，ASI 与 [[ashk]]（香港）、[[singapore-actuarial-society]]（新加坡）共同构成亚太资格地图，顶端框架见 [[iaa]]；② **数据科学落地**——该学会下属社区出品的 **[[actuarial-cookbook]]（Data and Analytics Cookbook）** 是「精算师如何真的用 Python/R 做数据工作」的高质量开源范例，另有 [[actuarialdatascience]] 一类资源；③ **政策与标准**——与 [[ifoa]]、[[soa]]、[[cas]] 形成国际参照。适合作职业路径规划、亚太资格对比与实务技能方向。
e.body_en: The Actuaries Institute (`actuaries.asn.au`) is **Australia’s actuarial professional body and qualifying body**. Its site is organised around career routes: what an actuary is, why become one, **career paths for actuaries**, the qualification pathway, membership and CPD, industry events and policy advocacy, plus published research and practice resources. Three layers of value for RIAA: (1) **regional qualification pathway** — Australia is a major pole of Asia-Pacific actuarial talent mobility, and together with [[ashk]] (Hong Kong) and [[singapore-actuarial-society]] (Singapore) it completes the Asia-Pacific qualification map, under the top-level framework of [[iaa]]; (2) **data science in practice** — the **[[actuarial-cookbook]] (Data and Analytics Cookbook)** produced by its community is a high-quality open-source example of how actuaries actually do data work in Python/R, alongside resources such as [[actuarialdatascience]]; (3) **policy and standards** — with international reference points [[ifoa]], [[soa]] and [[cas]]. Suits career-path planning, Asia-Pacific qualification comparison and practical-skills work.
e.body_hk: 澳洲精算學會（Actuaries Institute，`actuaries.asn.au`）是**澳大利亞的精算專業團體與資格授予機構**，站點結構圍繞職業路徑展開：What is an actuary / Why become an actuary / **Career paths for actuaries**、如何成為精算師、會員與 CPD、行業活動與政策倡導，並對外發布研究與實踐資源。對 RIAA 的價值有三層：① **區域資格路徑**——澳洲是亞太精算人才流動的重要一極，與 [[ashk]]（香港）、[[singapore-actuarial-society]]（新加坡）共同構成亞太資格地圖，頂端框架見 [[iaa]]；② **數據科學落地**——其社區出品的 **[[actuarial-cookbook]]** 是高質量開源範例，另有 [[actuarialdatascience]] 一類資源；③ **政策與標準**——與 [[ifoa]]、[[soa]]、[[cas]] 形成國際參照。適合作職業路徑規劃、亞太資格對比與實務技能方向。
